text: The 4×4 board starts empty; White places a king on rank 1, then Black on rank 4.
On each later turn, move one deployed piece or drop one owned reserve piece on an empty square.
A drop may not give check; a normal move may give check.
A captured rook, bishop, or knight returns to its original owner’s reserve.
Normal king safety and checkmate apply; stalemate and threefold repetition are draws.

mutual-two.description: Checking drops unlock permanently after both players have deployed two distinct non-kings.
text: The 4×4 board starts empty; White places a king on rank 1, then Black on rank 4.
On each later turn, move one deployed piece or drop one owned reserve piece on an empty square.
A drop may give check, just like a normal move.
Research variant: mutual-two.
Checking drops unlock permanently once both players have deployed two distinct non-kings.
A captured rook, bishop, or knight returns to its original owner’s reserve.
Normal king safety and checkmate apply; stalemate and threefold repetition are draws.

bank-3-quiet.description: Capture-to-bank capacity 3; overflow returns to captured owner. Quiet drops only.
text: The 4×4 board starts empty; White places a king on rank 1, then Black on rank 4.
On each later turn, move one deployed piece or drop one owned reserve piece on an empty square.
A drop may not give check; a normal move may give check.
Research variant: balance-bench.
Captures transfer to the capturer up to 3 held pieces; overflow returns to the captured side.

Bench options: {"unlock":0}. Delays tick after the reserve owner's completed play turns, excluding the capture turn for new arrivals. Forced wait only without legal actions and outside check; it consumes one ply. Initial reserves are ready.
Captured non-kings join the capturer’s reserve if fewer than 3 pieces are held; otherwise return to the captured side’s reserve.
Normal king safety and checkmate apply; stalemate and threefold repetition are draws.

learning.behavior: Shallow alpha-beta; seeded random choice among equally scored moves.

steady.behavior: Medium alpha-beta; seeded random choice among equally scored moves.

sharp.behavior: Deep alpha-beta; among equally scored moves, prefers the resulting position seen fewer times, while retaining a draw that avoids a worse score.

notes: Balance-v1 Sharp-only fixed-depth screening, not AI training. Six fresh seeds by default. Target: >=80% decisive and White share of decisive games 45–55%. No automatic full expansion. Compare complete schedules only; do not pool with CI stages or historical engine snapshots.
